t: This is Colnaghi, an art gallery on New Bond Street, and it claims to be the oldest commercial art gallery in the world. It was established in 1760. The dealer Konrad Bernheimer, a German art dealer and collector, once owned it. He also owns Bernheimer Fine Old Masters in Munich. In 2016 he sold Colnaghi to the Spanish dealers Jorge Coll and Nicolas Cortés. So you're looking at a business with more than two and a half centuries behind it, which has passed through several sets of hands.
